label: intrapetiolar
definition: A positional quality inhering in a stipule by virtue of its being placed in the axil between the petiole and the stem, often with the two stipules of a leaf fused into one.
reason: A standard stipule position (Rubiaceae, Polygonaceae, Hypericaceae) with no PATO or FLOPO term. A sibling of the positions FLOPO:0991000 axillary and FLOPO:0991001 leaf-opposed; 'interpetiolar' would be its natural sibling.

label: intramarginal
definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located near the margin of the structure that bears it and just inside it, running parallel to it. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991208 marginal.
reason: Used of veins, sori, indusia and gland dots set just inside the margin, which is distinct from FLOPO marginal (on the margin). Neither PATO nor FLOPO has a term.
